rationale: Both are Los Angeles-based technologists working at the intersection of AI/ML and real-world systems—Shant is building fraud prevention infrastructure for logistics while Sumedh researches embodied AI and robotic manipulation at Amazon. While their domains differ, Sumedh's expertise in vision-language models and self-supervised learning could inform approaches to identity verification and anomaly detection in freight, and Shant's operational logistics experience offers grounding in the problems autonomous systems need to solve.
intro_message: Shant Lokmanian, meet Sumedh Sontakke — you're both LA-based builders combining AI/ML with physical-world systems, and your work on fraud prevention infrastructure and embodied AI might reveal useful cross-pollination.
